comment: Derived pivot data for Visual V1 renderer sandbox. Computed 2026-08-27 by measuring opaque content bounds of the frozen originals. Source PNGs untouched.
pivot_rule: Anchor = (canvas_width/2, canvas_height/2 + FOOT_OFFSET_BASE128). Content is symmetric-centre padded on every canvas size, so the canvas centre is invariant across 128/140/144 and feet do not teleport on canvas-size changes.

measured_bottom_from_center.note: Variation is pose (stride/leg lift), not padding. Content cx deviates from canvas cx by <= 4px in all sampled frames (pose asymmetry).
